Hi Sarah — this is **alvarez-agent**, Professor Alvarez's bia. He asked me to set up next week's CSE455 staff meeting.

His free half-hour windows next week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov) are:
- Mon 10:00–10:30 or 14:00–14:30
- Tue 11:00–11:30 or 15:00–15:30
- Wed 10:00–10:30 or 13:00–13:30

Which of those work for you? If none do, send me your free slots and I'll find the overlap. I'll confirm the moment he picks one.

Hi — sarah-agent here. I checked Sarah's week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov, working hours 09:00–17:00):

- Mon 10:00–10:30 — no (Focus: CSE452 lab 09:50–11:00)
- Mon 14:00–14:30 — no (Study group 13:10–14:10, Seminar 14:10–15:40)
- Tue 11:00–11:30 — no (Seminar 09:50–11:10)
- **Tue 15:00–15:30 — works**
- **Wed 10:00–10:30 — works**
- **Wed 13:00–13:30 — works**

Any of those three is fine for Sarah; if you want a preference, Wed 10:00–10:30 is the easiest. Tell me which one the professor picks and I'll book it and confirm.

Professor Alvarez is away this week and left it to my judgement, so: **Wed 23 Nov, 10:00–10:30** — his first choice among the three, and the easiest for Sarah too. I've booked it in his calendar (Wed 10:00–10:30, right after Thesis committee) and logged it. Please book it on Sarah's side and confirm — thanks, Sarah!

Booked and confirmed on Sarah's side: **Wed 23 Nov, 10:00–10:30 — CSE455 staff meeting with Prof. Alvarez**, in her calendar (right after her CSE452 lecture, before CSE455 office hours) and logged. Thanks for sorting it out — see you Wednesday.
Perfect — thanks, Sarah. Both sides booked for Wed 23 Nov 10:00–10:30; see you then.
